reason: Wild babies keep out of fights, as her leashed ones do (Ed, 2026-11-13: "wild babies should avoid combat in the way that friendly babies do"; src/rules/wildBabies.ts): a wild baby with a fight within combat.defendRadius runs to a spot of its own area leash.babies.scatter off it and roams again leash.babies.calm seconds after; its roam and its notice of her leave it be meanwhile. Creatures carry a new optional field, shy. No new knobs.

rules.*: wherever a fight comes within 30 m of a wild baby: its place (run off from the fight), its roam's seeded draws after, and what follows from them; and the new shy field wherever a creature's fields are listed

frames.*: wherever a fight is in view near wild babies: the babies gone from beside it, further off in their area
